marks.gloss_en: R' Zeira: how is this different from an urn on top of an urn [which is permitted]?
התם אוקומי קא מוקים, הכא אולודי קא מוליד -- there he preserves, here he generates (= p_okumei_mokim, p_olodei_molid)
Rabba rebuked a servant who set a jug of water on the mouth of a kettle
R' Zeira: why [did you rebuke him]?
השתא חזית -- now you will see (and in the end he saw him wringing it, = p_avda_metzaer)
R' Zeira: how is this different from a pronka [which is permitted]?
התם לא קפיד עילויה, הכא קפיד עילויה -- there he is not particular about it, here he is (= p_pronka_lo_kapid, p_dastodar_kapid)
Rabba rebuked the servant who spread a kerchief over the mouth of a vat and set a cup on it
he does not renounce his basket of soft rags merely because he lacks one of straw (no SupportKind names an amora's own ground)
Abaye: because he has no basket of straw, does he stand and renounce a basket of soft rags?
לימא מסייע ליה -- the baraita has one insulate in soft rags and not move them, seemingly as Abaye
the baraita: one insulates in fleece, in combed wool, in strips of purple [wool] and in soft rags, and one may not move them
אי משום הא לא איריא: the baraita's 'one may not move them' speaks of rags he did not insulate in (= p_hachi_kaamar_im_lo_taman), so it says nothing about rags he did
this is what [the baraita] says: if he did not insulate in them, one may not move them
soft rags one insulated in may not be moved on Shabbat (asked by Rav Adda bar Mattana; Abaye's answer implies it)
תניא נמי הכי: one does not put stuffing in ... ; if it fell out, one returns it on Shabbat
if [the stuffing] fell out, one returns it on Shabbat, and needless to say on Yom Tov
איתיביה: one may not put soft stuffing into a pillow or cushion on Yom Tov, needless to say on Shabbat
Rav Chisda permitted returning stuffing to a pillow on Shabbat
לא קשיא, הא בחדתי הא בעתיקי -- the baraita is of new pillows, Rav Chisda's returning of old ones (= p_chadtei_veatikei)
no difficulty: this [the baraita's prohibition] is with new [pillows], that [Rav Chisda's returning] with old ones
מתקיף לה רב כהנא: מה בין זו למגופת חבית -- what is the difference between this and the stopper of a barrel? (kind svara: no ObjectionKind names מתקיף)
one who opens a neck-opening on Shabbat is liable to a sin-offering
